content.title: About
content.content: Slim Fast is a ready‑to‑drink nutritional shake that is sugar‑free and designed to support weight‑management goals. The formula provides a balanced mix of protein, vitamins, minerals, and dietary fiber to promote satiety without added sugar.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Slim Fast has been on the market for over 30 years and is continuously updated based on the latest nutrition science.
All flavors are formulated without added sugar.
Each serving contains roughly 200 kcal, making it a convenient meal replacement.
Protein is sourced from plant‑based ingredients such as soy or pea, delivering a complete amino‑acid profile.
The product is frequently used in diet programs recommended by nutrition professionals.

items.title: Supports weight control
items.content: Low‑calorie, high‑protein composition helps maintain fullness and reduce overall calorie intake.

items.title: Rich in B‑vitamins
items.content: Vitamins B1, B2, B6, and B12 aid normal metabolism and energy production.

items.title: Contains dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber promotes healthy digestion and helps stabilize blood‑sugar levels.

items.title: Sugar‑free
items.content: Absence of added sugar makes it suitable for those monitoring glycemic response.

items.title: Source of calcium and iron
items.content: Minerals support bone health and normal blood formation.

items.title: Soy or pea protein allergy
items.content: The drink may contain soy or pea proteins, which can trigger allergic reactions in sensitive individuals.

items.title: Limited nutritional variety
items.content: Relying solely on the shake for meals may lead to deficiencies in certain nutrients.

items.title: Possible gastrointestinal discomfort
items.content: High fiber content can cause bloating or loose stools if intake is increased abruptly.

items.title: Not suitable for children or pregnant women
items.content: Due to its specific composition and low calorie density, it is not recommended as the sole nutrition source for children, pregnant or nursing women.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Shake the bottle well before drinking and consume the entire serving within 30 minutes of opening. It can replace breakfast, lunch, or dinner, optionally paired with a side of fruit or vegetables for added volume.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Once opened, keep refrigerated and consume within 24 hours.
